lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, circular pixel clusters organized into at least five vertical columns on the lateral flank posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular blobs, establishing a repeating rectangular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a high-contrast transition from light to shadow in the vertical axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A semi-circular excision or notch is visible on the distal posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A small commensal fish is trailing the pectoral fin, which itself displays a high-density cluster of smaller, irregular high-luminance spots on its dorsal surface.
